review.notes: All 58 physical PDF pages were compared against the OCR with a normalized word-presence diff over the extracted text layer; every flagged cluster was individually resolved against the OCR and, where it indicated a repair, against a rendered page. Physical pages 9, 16 and 18 were rendered at 110 dpi and their footnote rules and the p.16 display equation were re-verified at 300 dpi. Confirmed repairs: three dropped footnote bodies whose superscript markers survived in the OCR, and one equation number printed with spaced digits. Structure is sound: the single balanced code fence carries the printed Algorithm 1 (Muon Optimizer) box; the two title-page H1 lines are the printed title and subtitle; numbered heading hierarchy matches the print; all 15 figure captions and 14 table captions are present, with 23 image embeds. Left unchanged as figure-internal or faithful: Figure 2 mHC panel labels (Residual/Pre-Block/Post-Block Mixing), Figure 12 chart axis labels, the Table 4 tool-call schema (carried by its embedded image), the arXiv watermark stamp on p.1, the p.8 RMSNorm and p.22 lcm equations (math-equivalent LaTeX), hyphenated line-break artifacts on pp.29/32/43, and the reference list including the DROP entry on p.53.
